description: Contains test fixture definitions and base classes for Orleans stream and cluster tests, specifically for testing Service Bus, Event Hub, and shared test environments.

classes.name: DefaultClusterTestCollection
classes.description: Defines a test collection for tests sharing a single Orleans cluster instance.

classes.name: TestEnvironmentFixtureCollection
classes.description: Defines a test collection for shared test environment configuration, including Azure Service Bus and Event Hub setup.

classes.name: BaseEventHubTestClusterFixture
classes.description: Abstract base fixture for Event Hub integration tests, managing connectivity checks and stream queue initialization.

methods.name: CheckPreconditionsOrThrow
methods.description: Checks for Event Hub preconditions before running tests; throws if not met.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture asynchronously, waits for stream queue measurements.
